sources.title: Antenna factor is the ratio of the incident electric field strength to the voltage induced at the antenna terminals, usually quoted in dB/m for a 50-ohm system.
For a 50-ohm antenna in the far field, AF(dB/m) = 20 log10(9.73 / lambda) - G(dBi), with lambda in metres and the constant derived from 4*pi*sqrt(30/50).
Field strength in dBµV/m is the received level in dBµV plus the antenna factor in dB/m; 0 dBµV is 1 µV and 0 dBµV/m is 1 µV/m.
